title: Omni pearl
description: This mod adds a new pearl that allows you to carry only one ender pearl instead of 50, which can be reused approximately 40 times. It functions like a tool with durability.
body:
Reusable teleportation pearl!

Throw it like a classic Ender Pearl: it flies, lands on a block and instantly teleports you to the impact location (with a small Enderman-like noise ).
Durability: 40 uses.
Easy to craft.

Elegant blue-green texture (customizable by editing the PNG file).

Simple and balanced crafting recipe :
4 diamonds, 1 Eye of Ender, 2 Ender Pearls.
